check: Desktop Native Power Mac menu and palette accessibility inspection, and fresh-store intent receipt
limitations: Fixture and in-process accessibility inspection only; no manual VoiceOver, Voice Control, Full Keyboard Access, keypress, pointer, or system intent authentication/parameter resolution.

The initial bare NSHostingView harness exposed an unnamed outline and failed; a method-level filtered retry selected zero tests and proves nothing. NSHostingController with native window integration passed the complete four-test suite.
The result bundle recorded recoverable toolbar constraint warnings in the off-screen window. This is not proof of visual layout, large text, contrast, or focus order.
No native document scene, system Services delivery, file panel, physical mobile device, or 26-SDK compile.

outcome.detail: Four tests executed and passed, zero failed/skipped/expected failures. Every desktop command was in the running app menu with a shortcut and matching menu name. All seven command titles and a Close button were exposed by the hosted palette accessibility tree. The actual intent runner committed a createItem receipt admitted as app-intent on a fresh SQLite store. The 23-observation hosted replay also passed.
